name: methods
value: Survival was estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method. Frequency weights from stset were treated with replication semantics for counts and Greenwood RMST variance. Median survival time with 95% confidence intervals is reported. Restricted mean survival time was computed up to 3 years with 95% confidence intervals based on the Greenwood variance formula. Analysis performed in Stata 17 (StataCorp, College Station, TX).
